text:
claire_mkt: quick sync 1  we need a compact SEO ops bundle for next week's webinar push. scope: webinar landing, hero launch post, 3 pillar posts, and the thanks page. deliverables: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor map, UTM schema. target: ready for staging QA Tue EOD.

tom_seo: i'll own keyword clusters + redirect CSV. keeping 3 longtails per page + one canonical per cluster. will limit redirects to necessary merges only.

anya_prod: messaging: which value prop goes into meta descriptions? "predictable latency" or "cost controls"?

leo_growth: tests show "predictable latency" nudges signups in top-funnel. lean into that for hero/meta; keep cost angle in remarketing.

raj_eng: redirect window Wed 04:30-05:30 UTC. plan: apply 302s, run analytics smoke tests, flip to 301s after green. rel=canonical headers added in same window. SRE on standby.

tom_seo: sample redirect lines I'll add to CSV: 
old_path,new_path,type,notes
/webinar-beta,/webinar,302,validate tracking first
/blog/launch-draft,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicates
/offer/old-thanks,/thanks,301,consolidate

tom_seo: schema quick: webinar -> Event JSON-LD (name,startDate,url,organizer,offers if gated). blogs -> BlogPosting + mainEntityOfPage + image. I'll paste snippets to the ticket.

anya_prod: anchor plan: hero intro links to pillar A & B; webinar landing right-rail links to pillar C and the thanks page. use descriptive anchors, avoid exact-match stuffing.

leo_growth: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_launch, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=jun_launch, utm_content variants hero/email/social. maps to HubSpot.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-9021 "Webinar SEO ops: redirects, schema, anchors, UTMs"  assignees: tom_seo, anya_prod, leo_growth, raj_eng. Reminder set for 2024-06-18T09:00:00Z.

claire_mkt: thanks all  i'll do a final preflight Tue after deliverables land. :rocket:
